name: harness
description: Harness — a lightweight reasoning floor. Pass a raw request; a fixed six-stage engine runs Plan(opus) → SetGoal(opus, adversarial critic) → Implement(sonnet, repo-skill executors with optional local Codex CLI bridge) → Test(sonnet, deterministic evidence) → QualityGate(opus, bounded loop + goal-level gate) → Report(sonnet). Filters repetition and below-threshold answers regardless of main-session model. B (request + engine) default; A (bespoke Workflow) for custom control flow. Enforcement: opt-in PreToolUse gate — projects list gated paths in .claude/harness-gate.json; edits there require harness engagement (fail-open). The install skill scaffolds a project: it embeds the self-contained gate hook (copies goal-gate.mjs into .claude/hooks/ and merges a PreToolUse entry into committed .claude/settings.json), plus gate config, default conventions (coding/verification/boundaries), and an ambient CLAUDE.md section — project-owned copies, never overwritten. It also optionally embeds the engine + Codex CLI adapter/runner + statically-referenced skills into .claude/harness/ for plugin-less environments (opt-in; dynamic subgoal skills[] cannot be pre-enumerated). Mode M: for control flow the fixed stages cannot express, the harness generates a bespoke Workflow from templates/meta-skeleton.js (contract preserved: judge≠actor, model pins, bounded loops, deterministic Test, goal-level gate). Workflow path: when codex_provider is not off, SetGoal may mark code-oriented Implement subgoals with implement_provider: "codex"; the Sonnet Implement agent then calls engine/codex-exec-adapter.mjs, reads the codex exec --json result, and emits the normal HANDOFF, falling back to direct Sonnet implementation if Codex is unavailable or fails. Workflow-less fallback (engine/fallback.md): when the Workflow tool is absent, the same six stages run via fresh per-stage Agent subagents exchanging files in a run directory, closed by fallback-check.mjs; fallback may also route Implement/Test through separate codex exec --json processes. Codex-only environments can run engine/codex-runner.mjs for the same file-artifact harness contract without Claude Workflow. SetGoal may also optionally map the repo harness-aware dual-mode skills (writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development, etc.) as subgoal executors; none is required.
